The call bells are checked daily as part of routine maintenance however the document which records the checks is pre populated with a 'P' for pass. This could lead to rooms being missed in the checks or a failure to correct a 'P' to an 'F' in the event of a fail. It may be the case that in the event of another patient requiring a call bell and it not working this could make a significant difference to the outcome for that individual and for that reason the maintenance arrangements are important.
